none: PAS CAM-EC24C6: Roman Coin : A silver incomplete Denarius of Julia Mamaea
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver incomplete Denarius of Julia Mamaea. AD222-235 (Reece period 11). Reverse legend reads [FECV]ND [AVGVSTAE]. Reverse shows Fecunditas standing left, (holding hand over child and holding patera and cornucopiae). Mint is Rome. See RIC IV, pt.II, p.98, no.331. Note: This coin has been deliberately cut around the outline of the bust on the obverse. Obverse shows Diademed head right. Obverse…
